name: Kyou kara Omae no Tsuma wa Ore no Mono ~Irekawatte Taninzuma ni Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: 今日からお前の妻は俺のモノ ～入れ替わって他人妻にヤリたい放題～
source:
Kazuma Hasebe is going nowhere fast, working multiple jobs just to make ends meet. After a bad day of gambling, he's skulking around town when he runs into Nao, the "hot girl" from back when he was still in school. She doesn't remember him. Actually, she's visibly disgusted at the sight of him, and when Nao's fiancé Takauji shows up he piles on the abuse as well. The whole traumatic experience transforms Kazuma into a stalker.

One day, while peeking into Nao's apartment, he gets into a tussle with Takauji and they take a fall down a flight of stairs. Nao hears the commotion and runs out to fuss over Takauji... but something is different.

Kazuma and Takauji have somehow swapped bodies! Takauji tries to explain the freak occurrence—but now he's the freak, and Nao won't even give him the time of day. Seeing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, Kazuma takes over as Takauji on the spot.

With a brand-new life in a brand-new body, what was once a living hell for Kazuma is now paradise on earth! But how will his love-hate relationship with Nao influence his new life decisions? And how long will his body swap even last...?

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/kyoukaraomaenotsumahaorenom-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
长谷部一马 (Kazuma Hasebe) 前途无量，为了维持收支平衡而打几份工。赌博度过了糟糕的一天后，他在城里鬼鬼祟祟地闲逛，这时他遇到了Nao，也就是他上学时的“辣妹”。她不记得他了。事实上，她一看到他就明显感到厌恶，当菜绪的未婚夫高氏出现时，他也开始辱骂。整个痛苦的经历让和真变成了跟踪狂。

有一天，在窥探菜绪的公寓时，他与高氏发生了争执，他们从楼梯上摔了下来。奈央听到骚动，跑出去对高氏大惊小怪……但有些东西不一样了。

和真和高氏不知怎么交换了身体！高氏试图解释这一反常现象——但现在他就是反常分子，奈绪甚至不肯给他时间。看到千载难逢的机会，和真当场接任高氏。

全新的身体里有了全新的生命，曾经的地狱对于和真来说，现在变成了人间天堂！但他与奈绪的爱恨情仇将如何影响他新的人生决定呢？而他的身体交换还能持续多久……？
